summary: Build practical cross-cultural service skills with CQ and communication frameworks. Explore the five-day course outline and enrol.
lede: Cultural sensitivity in customer service means adapting how you interpret and respond to customer cues without relying on stereotypes. For service agents, supervisors and quality reviewers, this foundation-level training develops skills for checking interpretations, clarifying meaning, adapting tone and de-escalating difficult exchanges. Using the Cultural Intelligence framework and Hall’s context lens, learners practise reviewing conversations, planning clear service handoffs and calibrating quality reviews; AI-assisted translation is covered at an awareness level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who handle customer conversations, review service quality or coach teams serving customers with varied communication preferences.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is required. Familiarity with customer-facing service work will help you connect the exercises to your role. Programming: Coding is not required. The AI-assisted translation content focuses on review and decision-making, not system configuration.
